first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so simplifying onboarding addresses the two observed funnel problems with one experiment. Prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improved completion, time-to-value, and durable SMB activation. Verify both records to confirm the effect sizes, guardrails, and applicability before committing. A standard experiment is appropriate to detect meaningful movement while preserving a control group.
